title: Warehouse user delivers part of a confirmed sales order: 3 of 5 chairs, the rest to a backorder; the order reads partially delivered
_seedNote: the delivery comes from a confirmed sales order (J-SALES-01 confirms 5 Office Chairs for Azure Interior; enough chairs on hand makes it Ready — J-INV-04 tops them up). Backorders (2 chairs) are excluded from the seed so a re-run never picks one.

seeds.name: deliveryNo
seeds.sql: SELECT t.Number AS n FROM Inventory.Transfer AS t WHERE t.Status = 'Ready' AND t/Inventory.Transfer_OperationType/Inventory.OperationType/Kind = 'Delivery' AND t/Inventory.Transfer_SalesOrder/Sales.SalesOrder/Number != NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT b.ID FROM Inventory.Transfer AS b WHERE t/Inventory.Transfer_Backorder = b.ID) ORDER BY t.ScheduledDate DESC LIMIT 1

seeds.name: orderNo
seeds.sql: SELECT t/Inventory.Transfer_SalesOrder/Sales.SalesOrder/Number AS n FROM Inventory.Transfer AS t WHERE t.Number = '{{deliveryNo}}'

steps.name: Open Inventory > Transfers: the delivery is listed
Open the delivery: Ready, the order's chairs reserved

oql.label: the delivery carries the order as its source document (shown in an input, which textPresent cannot read)
oql.sql: SELECT COUNT(t.ID) AS n FROM Inventory.Transfer AS t WHERE t.Number = '{{deliveryNo}}' AND t.SourceDocument = '{{orderNo}}'

steps.name: Process 3 of the 5 chairs and validate: the backorder question opens

actions.label: Validate — straight after typing, as a user would

steps.name: Create backorder: the delivery is done and the rest waits on a new delivery for the same order

oql.label: the delivery is done with 3 chairs
oql.sql: SELECT COUNT(t.ID) AS n FROM Inventory.Transfer AS t WHERE t.Number = '{{deliveryNo}}' AND t.Status = 'Done' AND t.DateDone != NULL

oql.label: the backorder carries the 2 chairs not delivered
oql.sql: SELECT COUNT(m.ID) AS n FROM Inventory.StockMove AS m WHERE m/Inventory.StockMove_Transfer/Inventory.Transfer/Inventory.Transfer_Backorder/Inventory.Transfer/Number = '{{deliveryNo}}' AND m.DemandQuantity = 2

outcome.label: the sales order reads partially delivered, 3 delivered on its line
outcome.sql: SELECT COUNT(o.ID) AS n FROM Sales.SalesOrder AS o WHERE o.Number = '{{orderNo}}' AND o.DeliveryStatus = 'PartiallyDelivered'
